decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program sits close to the core offer, is still listed in 2024, and costs a large firm with slack little to carry, so nothing signals a shortfall against aspiration.

The seventy-two-hour program is operationally demanding and overlaps with the other express offers, which carries some risk of consolidation, but it stayed visible in 2024 and fits the firm's fast-response positioning.
It has kept its own dedicated page for two years, which suggests satisfactory performance and continued management commitment within a growing industry.

The online ordering and digital services platform is a strategic investment serving trade partners, has its own page, and matches the firm's direction toward deeper service support, so dropping it is unlikely.
It was upgraded to its own page in 2024 and appears to have absorbed the fire-protection role of the withdrawn Product C, which indicates results at or above aspiration.
